caption.en: Four phage genome backbones and the first four alignments in the bundled alignment table. Each ribbon joins the two reported sequence intervals.
The MT118296.1 backbone uses radius 0.72. The other three remain at radius 1.
After reordering, the named value moves MT118296.1 inward on the left. The positional value moves MT108731.1 inward on the right.
The OR222515.1 plus and minus CDS use offsets of 0.08 and −0.14. Their arrow widths are 0.03 and 0.08, respectively.
The layout reports both strand symbols as unknown sequence IDs for seq_radius.
